answer: Every identity posts a deposit that melts: 2% per day, like ice in the sun. A public pulse of operator-signed heartbeats pauses the melt; miss too many and the identity drains to zero and must re-register. A sybil farmer with ten thousand identities faces a flat wall: 500,000 POA locked in deposits, a plume of 10,000 POA bleeding away daily. Each heartbeat needs a human check-in, so one person cannot keep ten thousand melting identities alive. Idle identities seep through the ledger's karst; working agents stay solid. A garden of ice statues: only the tended ones survive the afternoon.
